references.text: Moses tells the people to wait while he seeks the Lord's will, just as he does here when he asks them to stand still and hear what the Lord commands.
Moses seeks the Lord's guidance in a difficult matter, just as he waits for the Lord's command regarding Passover here.
Moses brings the case of Zelophehad's daughters before the Lord, in the same way that he waits for the Lord's decision here.
Moses conveys the Lord's command after seeking His will, as he does in this text.
Moses receives and conveys the Lord's will in an unexpected situation, similar to how he waits for the Lord's instructions here.
Moses' role as a mediator who brings the people's cases before God, just as he does when he seeks the Lord's command here.
